meta.title: Rodo Armas — Strategy, engineering & agentic AI
meta.description: Rodo Armas is a Strategy & Planning Coordinator at Uber Eats LatAm, an industrial engineer from PUC Chile, and a builder of agentic strategy tools. Robotics, photography and the mountains keep the thinking sharp.

hero.headline: Curiosity, engineered.
hero.lede: Engineer by training, strategist by choice, and a little bit of everything by curiosity. Robots taught me how systems behave, a camera taught me what to look at, and AI agents let me think at a new scale. Strategy is where it all comes together.

stats.label: National #1 score on Chile's university admission test
Rank out of 931 in my engineering class
To ship an AI finance analyst at Platanus Hack
Years teaching across five university courses

about.body: I studied Industrial Engineering at PUC Chile, specialized in robotics, and fell for strategy along the way. I collect skills the way other people collect stamps, because each one gives me a new way to see a problem. Building a machine teaches patience with complexity. Framing a photo teaches what to leave out. Skiing a run you haven't tried teaches you to commit. Lately I've added a new one: designing AI agents that research, model and draft alongside me, so I can spend my own thinking on the questions that matter most. Today I bring all of it to Strategy & Planning at Uber Eats LatAm.

chapters.title: Numbers → clarity
chapters.body: A national #1 score on Chile's university admission test was the first clue: I love finding the order hidden inside a problem.

chapters.title: Robots → systems
chapters.body: Build a machine that has to catch a falling barbell and you learn that every part talks to every other part. I still think about businesses that way.

chapters.title: Teaching → simplicity
chapters.body: Four years as a teaching assistant, the last two leading the team, showed me that if I can't explain it simply, I don't understand it yet.

chapters.title: Agents → leverage
chapters.body: At Uber Eats, and as a BCG Case Competition 2026 finalist, I pair strategic thinking with AI agents I design myself, and point everything I've learned at problems that matter.

projects.title: Strategy & Planning at Uber Eats
projects.summary: Planning, pricing and growth questions across Latin American markets, from first diagnosis to a decision. The full story is coming soon.

projects.title: Agentic strategy & development
projects.summary: I design AI agents that research, model and build alongside me. Lucas, an AI personal-finance analyst, went from idea to launched prototype in a 36-hour hackathon.

projects.title: An autonomous bench-press spotter
projects.summary: My robotics capstone: mechanics, electronics and control logic that detect a failed rep and step in to help, all for under $100.

bento.title: Every skill sharpens how I think

tiles.title: Think in systems
tiles.body: Robotics taught me to follow every cause to its effect, in machines and in markets.

tiles.title: Work with agents
tiles.body: AI agents take the legwork so my attention goes to judgment.

tiles.title: Let data speak
tiles.body: Good numbers end debates and start better ones.

tiles.title: Frame what matters
tiles.body: Photography is the art of choosing what stays in the picture. So is strategy.

tiles.title: Prototype the idea
tiles.body: An idea feels different once it runs. I'd rather test it in 36 hours than debate it for 36 days.

tiles.title: Commit to the line
tiles.body: Skiing, tennis and adventure trips teach the same lesson: read the terrain, then go.

interests.title: Photography
interests.body: Always carrying a camera. It trains me to notice what everyone else walks past.

interests.title: Robotics & making
interests.body: Motors, sensors and 3D-printed parts. Nothing beats an idea you can hold.

interests.title: Ski, tennis & adventure
interests.body: Mountains, courts and new trails. The best way I know to reset and get bold.

entries.body: Coordinator since July 2026 after joining as an intern in September 2025. Diagnostics, forecasting and scenario work for markets across the region.

photography.title: What I see when I slow down
photography.body: Photography is how I practice noticing. A full gallery is on its way.
